import '@en-reve/elements/define/rich-text-editor.js';import '@en-reve/elements/define/token-editor.js'; import {richDocumentFromRuns,richDocumentText} from '@en-reve/elements/rich-document.js'; import {createEditorCommandMatcher} from '@en-reve/elements/editor-command-matcher.js'; const rich=document.querySelector('en-rich-text-editor'),plain=document.querySelector('en-token-editor'),receipt=document.querySelector('#receipt');let range; const reset=()=>{rich.document=richDocumentFromRuns([{kind:'text',text:'Alpha and Beta review '},{kind:'token',id:'reference-1',type:'reference',text:'@Design',label:'Design reference',data:{key:'design'}}]);range=undefined;receipt.textContent=richDocumentText(rich.document);}; for(const editor of [rich,plain]){ editor.registerToken('reference',token=>document.createTextNode(token.text),{importToken:(token,context)=>{receipt.textContent=`Imported source occurrence ${context.sourceId}`;return token;}}); editor.registerExtension({id:'commands',trigger:'/',label:'Commands',match:createEditorCommandMatcher(['insert table']),provide:()=>[{id:'table',label:'Insert table',insert:[{kind:'text',text:'[Table]'}]}]}); } for(const button of document.querySelectorAll('button'))button.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>event.preventDefault()); document.querySelector('#capture').onclick=()=>{range=rich.captureRange();receipt.textContent=JSON.stringify(range,null,2)??'No valid range';}; document.querySelector('#decorate').onclick=()=>{receipt.textContent=String(range&&rich.decorateRanges([{id:'review',range}]));}; document.querySelector('#replace').onclick=()=>{receipt.textContent=String(range&&rich.replaceRanges([{range,runs:[{kind:'text',text:'Revised'}]}]));}; document.querySelector('#undo').onclick=()=>rich.undo();document.querySelector('#reset').onclick=reset;reset(); if(new URL(location.href).searchParams.has('progress-report')){const a=document.createElement('a');a.className='report';a.href='http://127.0.0.1:4177';a.textContent='Progress Report';document.body.append(a);}
